sources.title: Privacy Policy - Privacy & Terms - Google
sources.snippet: As described there, when Google anonymizes data to protect your privacy, we maintain policies and technical measures to avoid re-identifying that information. U.S. state privacy laws also provide the right to request information about how Google collects, uses, and discloses your information.
